CVE-2011-1595.title: Directory traversal vulnerability in the disk_create function in  ...
CVE-2011-1595.description: Directory traversal vulnerability in the disk_create function in disk.c in rdesktop before 1.7.0, when disk redirection is enabled, allows remote RDP servers to read or overwrite arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in a pathname.

CVE-2019-15682.title: RDesktop version 1.8.4 contains multiple out-of-bound access read ...
CVE-2019-15682.description: RDesktop version 1.8.4 contains multiple out-of-bound access read vulnerabilities in its code, which results in a denial of service (DoS) condition. This attack appear to be exploitable via network connectivity. These issues have been fixed in version 1.8.5
